what: Over the panel, each time the cursor moves by panel width ÷ 8 (touch ÷ 6), one badge (a round sticker or logo image) pops out at the cursor position, offset horizontally by ±40%, at 1.3× and ±10°, and settles to 1× with elastic.out(2, .6) over .4s. During the same .4s it is pushed twice that distance in the last movement direction (power1.in) and falls to the bottom edge of the screen (back.in(1.1) — rising briefly, then falling, .9×), then over the next .3s it is pushed another 1.6× while tilting ±20° and drops out below (back.in, harder the higher on the screen it was released). Up to 8 at once, and the badge images are used in rotation.

options.per: One item per this many divisions of the panel width, default 8 (touch 6)

note: Badge size is --fx-badge (default 15vw · phone 35vw). The badge child is the hidden original and is cloned and floated when moving

from.where: On all pages the footer .bw-foot__mark — original MwgFreeEffect002 (fallMode viewport, spawnDistanceDivisor 9): elastic.out(2, 0.6) .4 · back.in(1.1) .4 · back.in(1.5+…) .3, max 8
